_targets_comment: ALL geographies. 'level' is matched (exact or case-insensitive substring) against each item's actual reporting-level options, so e.g. 'ZIP' resolves to 'ZIP Codes'. geoTypeLabel picks the service-area type; seedGeoId is a valid geo of that type (from GetGeoSelections). MSA has no service-area type, so it seeds via Counties and reports up.
